goal: The head of Nan in profile, the nose clearly seen, for a word check row.

Keep her look from picture 1: black-brown hair with exactly two round buns, one on each side of the head, each with a smooth red ring band (you see the near bun on the side of the head, behind the ear; there is no bun on top of the head and no ruffled scrunchie, no fabric ruffles), a large dark-brown eye with white highlights and one short thick curved eyelash flick, and an orange T-shirt. Keep the soft, round, bright 3D render look, not a 2D drawing and no outlines. The picture: a square close picture of Nan's head and the top of her shoulders in an EXACT side view (90 degrees), like picture 1. The face looks to the left edge of the picture, and the whole face profile shows: forehead, brow, one eye, the nose, the lips, and the chin. The nose tip is the most forward point of the face outline and stands out clearly as a small round nose in profile, with the bridge of the nose and the nostril clearly seen. Only ONE eye shows (the near eye): the far eye is not seen at all, and no sliver of a second eye shows at the edge of the face. Do NOT show the back of the head, do NOT turn her face toward the camera, and do NOT show a three-quarter view. The head fills most of the square, as large as possible, in the middle of the picture. The lower edge of the picture cuts straight through the shoulders just below the neck, so only the head, the neck, and the very top of the shoulders and T-shirt show. No arm and no hand are in the picture. The T-shirt is one even orange with no pale patches. The background is plain white and empty. The page text is context only: do not draw any text. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos. The picture is for young children and is rated G. There is no line or crease on the forehead.
